_note: Read 17 September 2026. Two pages on the developer's own site were read: https://www.alhabtoorcity.com/en (home) and https://www.alhabtoorcity.com/en/the-residences. The site is a Next.js app that serves its pictures from the developer's own CDN bucket al-habtoor-city.fra1.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com; the originals are listed here rather than the /_next/image resizer URLs. Everything is published openly - no form anywhere. Nothing on either page is a floor plan. The developer's filenames are mostly generic ('residence-1', '001'), so notes describe plainly and no room is invented. Deliberately excluded: logos, the loyalty-programme banner, and the photographs of nearby attractions the site uses as a neighbourhood guide (Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall fountains, Museum of the Future, Green Planet, Dubai Garden Glow, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Canal, La Perle) - those are not this development.
